owner_titles: Chairman of the Board and CEO
footnote_text: Represents shares of common stock issuable upon vesting and settlement of the reporting person's return on invested capital ("ROIC") performance restricted stock units granted on November 26, 2025 for the fiscal years 2026 through 2028 performance period (the "FY26-28 ROIC PSUs"), consisting of 3,488 shares attributable to fiscal year 2026 performance and 9 shares attributable to accrued dividend equivalents. On November 10, 2026, the Human Capital & Compensation Committee certified the fiscal year 2026 ROIC performance factor at 200%, the maximum level. This factor is one of three equally weighted annual factors that will be averaged after fiscal year 2028 to determine the number of shares that will vest under the FY26-28 ROIC PSUs. The reported shares remain unvested and subject to final performance certification, the terms of the applicable award agreement, and the Company's 2017 Omnibus Incentive Plan.
